facts.text: The Reader helped wipe the frost from the lamp's glass.

The Reader found Wick's logbook in the snow.
facts.page: You found Wick's logbook in the snow.

facts.text: Pip dug Wick's logbook out of the snow.
facts.page: Pip dug Wick's logbook out of the snow, with you beside him.

facts.text: Pip threw a line across the gap to Wick.
facts.page: You saw Pip throw Wick a line across the gap.

facts.text: Wick crossed the gap on a ladder, one rung at a time.
facts.page: You gave Pip the ladder that got Wick across the gap.

facts.text: Wick flew over the gap on a kite, at his age.
facts.page: You gave Pip the kite that flew Wick over the gap.

facts.text: Wick handed Pip the lamp and the log, and Pip got a star of his own.
facts.page: You saw Wick hand Pip the lamp, and Pip's star come out on your ceiling.
